nights.title: ElGrandeToto - SALGOAT WORLD TOUR 2
nights.name: ElGrandeToto
nights.extract: Taha Fahssi, better known by his stage name ElGrandeToto, EGT or just Toto, is a Moroccan rapper from Casablanca. He has been the most streamed artist in Morocco for five consecutive years (2021-2025) and was the most listened-to artist in the MENA region on Spotify in 2021 and 2023. He is also the most viewed Moroccan rapper on YouTube. Fahssi is widely regarded as one of Morocco's best rappers of all time.

en.who: Taha Fahssi, better known by his stage name ElGrandeToto, EGT or just Toto, is a Moroccan rapper from Casablanca. Fahssi is widely regarded as one of Morocco's best rappers of all time.
facts: He has been the most streamed artist in Morocco for five consecutive years (2021-2025) and was the most listened-to artist in the MENA region on Spotify in 2021 and 2023.

de.who: Taha Fahssi, besser bekannt unter dem Künstlernamen ElGrandeToto, EGT oder einfach Toto, ist ein marokkanischer Rapper aus Casablanca. Fahssi gilt als einer der besten Rapper Marokkos aller Zeiten.
facts: Er war fünf Jahre in Folge (2021–2025) der meistgestreamte Künstler in Marokko und 2021 sowie 2023 der meistgehörte Künstler der MENA-Region auf Spotify.
Außerdem ist er der meistgesehene marokkanische Rapper auf YouTube.

tr.who: Taha Fahssi, ElGrandeToto, EGT ya da kısaca Toto sahne adlarıyla tanınan, Casablanca'dan bir Faslı rapçidir. Fahssi, Fas'ın tüm zamanların en iyi rapçilerinden biri olarak kabul edilir.
facts: 2021'den 2025'e kadar beş yıl üst üste Fas'ta en çok dinlenen sanatçı oldu; 2021 ve 2023'te Spotify'da MENA bölgesinde en çok dinlenen sanatçıydı.
Ayrıca YouTube'da en çok izlenen Faslı rapçidir.

nights.title: Bob Dylan
nights.name: Bob Dylan
nights.extract: Bob Dylan is an American singer-songwriter. Described as one of the greatest songwriters of all time, Dylan has been a major figure in popular culture over his 69-year career. Dylan added increasingly sophisticated lyrical techniques to the folk music of the early 1960s, infusing it "with the intellectualism of classic literature and poetry". His lyrics incorporated political, social, and philosophical influences, defying pop music conventions and appealing to the burgeoning counterculture.

en.who: Bob Dylan is an American singer-songwriter. Described as one of the greatest songwriters of all time, Dylan has been a major figure in popular culture over his 69-year career.
facts: Dylan added increasingly sophisticated lyrical techniques to the folk music of the early 1960s, infusing it "with the intellectualism of classic literature and poetry".
His lyrics incorporated political, social, and philosophical influences, defying pop music conventions and appealing to the burgeoning counterculture.

de.who: Bob Dylan ist ein amerikanischer Singer-Songwriter. Er gilt als einer der größten Songwriter aller Zeiten und hat über eine Karriere von 69 Jahren eine zentrale Rolle in der Popkultur gespielt.
facts: Dylan verfeinerte die Folkmusik der frühen 1960er-Jahre mit zunehmend anspruchsvollen lyrischen Techniken und verband sie "mit dem Intellektualismus der klassischen Literatur und Poesie".
Seine Texte griffen politische, soziale und philosophische Einflüsse auf, stellten Konventionen der Popmusik infrage und sprachen die aufkeimende Gegenkultur an.

tr.who: Bob Dylan, Amerikalı bir şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. Tüm zamanların en büyük söz yazarlarından biri olarak tanımlanan Dylan, 69 yıllık kariyeri boyunca popüler kültürün önemli isimlerinden biri olmuştur.
facts: Dylan, 1960'ların başındaki folk müziğe giderek daha sofistike sözsel teknikler ekledi ve onu "klasik edebiyat ve şiirin entelektüelliğiyle" besledi.
Sözleri politik, sosyal ve felsefi etkileri içeriyordu; pop müziğin kurallarını zorladı ve yükselen karşı kültüre hitap etti.

nights.title: Kodaline - Farewell Tour
nights.name: Kodaline
nights.extract: Kodaline are an Irish rock band. Originally known as 21 Demands, the band adopted their current name in 2012 to coincide with the changing of their music. The group comprises Steve Garrigan, Vincent May, Mark Prendergast, and Jason Boland.

facts: Originally known as 21 Demands, the band adopted their current name in 2012 to coincide with the changing of their music.
The group comprises Steve Garrigan, Vincent May, Mark Prendergast, and Jason Boland.

de.who: Kodaline sind eine irische Rockband. Die Band hat vier Mitglieder.

Zur Gruppe gehören Steve Garrigan, Vincent May, Mark Prendergast und Jason Boland.

tr.who: Kodaline, İrlandalı bir rock grubudur. Grubun dört üyesi vardır.
facts: Başlangıçta 21 Demands adıyla bilinen grup, müziğinin değişimine paralel olarak 2012'de bugünkü adını aldı.
Grubun üyeleri Steve Garrigan, Vincent May, Mark Prendergast ve Jason Boland'dır.

nights.title: Night Lovell - My Blood As The Ink Tour
nights.name: Night Lovell
nights.extract: Shermar Cuba Paul, known professionally as Night Lovell, is a Canadian rapper, songwriter and record producer. He initially gained fame after his song Dark Light went viral in 2014. He has released four studio albums named Red Teenage Melody released on June 13, 2016, Goodnight Lovell released on February 22, 2019, Just Say You Don't Care, released May 6, 2021, and I Hope You're Happy released on December 8, 2023. He was a featured artist on American YouTuber and musician Corpse Husband's "Hot Demon Bitches Near U ! ! !", which released on September 3, 2021.

en.kicker: canadian rapper and record producer · frankfurt
en.who: Shermar Cuba Paul, known professionally as Night Lovell, is a Canadian rapper, songwriter and record producer. He initially gained fame after his song Dark Light went viral in 2014.

de.who: Shermar Cuba Paul, unter dem Namen Night Lovell bekannt, ist ein kanadischer Rapper, Songwriter und Musikproduzent. Bekannt wurde er zunächst durch seinen Song Dark Light, der 2014 viral ging.
facts: Er hat vier Studioalben veröffentlicht, darunter I Hope You're Happy, das am 8. Dezember 2023 erschien.
Eines seiner vier Studioalben, Red Teenage Melody, erschien am 13. Juni 2016.

tr.kicker: kanadalı rapçi ve plak yapımcısı · frankfurt
tr.who: Shermar Cuba Paul, Night Lovell sahne adıyla bilinen, Kanadalı bir rapçi, söz yazarı ve plak yapımcısıdır. Şöhretini ilk olarak 2014'te viral olan Dark Light şarkısıyla kazandı.
facts: Dört stüdyo albümü yayımladı; bunlar arasında 8 Aralık 2023'te çıkan I Hope You're Happy de var.
Albümlerinden Red Teenage Melody, 13 Haziran 2016'da yayımlandı.

nights.title: Loreena McKennitt: The Mask and Mirror - 30th Anniversary Tour
nights.name: Loreena McKennitt
nights.extract: Loreena McKennitt is a Canadian singer-songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, and composer who writes, records, and performs world music with Celtic and Middle Eastern influences. McKennitt is known for her refined and clear soprano vocals. She has sold more than 16 million records worldwide.

en.who: Loreena McKennitt is a Canadian singer-songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, and composer. She writes, records, and performs world music with Celtic and Middle Eastern influences.
facts: McKennitt is known for her refined and clear soprano vocals.
She has sold more than 16 million records worldwide.

de.who: Loreena McKennitt ist eine kanadische Singer-Songwriterin, Multiinstrumentalistin und Komponistin. Sie schreibt, nimmt auf und präsentiert Weltmusik mit keltischen und nahöstlichen Einflüssen.
facts: McKennitt ist für ihre verfeinerte und klare Sopranstimme bekannt.
Sie hat weltweit mehr als 16 Millionen Tonträger verkauft.

tr.who: Loreena McKennitt, Kanadalı bir şarkıcı, söz yazarı, çok enstrümanlı müzisyen ve bestecidir. Kelt ve Orta Doğu etkileri taşıyan dünya müziğini yazar, kaydeder ve icra eder.
facts: McKennitt, rafine ve berrak soprano sesiyle tanınır.
Dünya genelinde 16 milyondan fazla plak sattı.
